messages:
nora (CS): hi team, drafting a one-page 'stability quick-run' for onboarding conversations with renewal-risk accounts. want a 15-minute customer walkthrough + a scannable checklist with runnable steps. posting draft below for fast review.

liyah (ENG): short + prescriptive is perfect. field defaults i recommend: cache_ttl 22s, max_batch 12, batch_timeout 10ms, streaming=true. include a safe read-only curl for quick diagnostics.

liyah (ENG): ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"<sample prompt>","stream":false}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '{lat_p50:.latencies.p50,lat_p95:.latencies.p95,cache_hit_rate:.cache.hit_rate}'
```

omar (CS Ops): pre-warm playbook for CS to run: 1) prefill: push top-6 prompts once at ~7 qps for 45s to seed prefix cache; 2) warm-run: run 120 synthetic sessions at 2 qps for 3 minutes to stabilize KV cache; 3) smoke: capture lat_p50, lat_p95, cache_hit_rate, tokens_per_req, error_rate and attach 3 traces to ticket.

jade (DE): put a one-line decision header at the top of the page: "cache_hit_rate < 20% -> enable client prefill; tokens_per_req > 350 -> trim context or request a quantized model; p95 > 900ms -> reduce batch_timeout or enable streaming." keeps it scannable for PMs.

ops-bot: reminder: attach the last 10 warm-run traces to the tenant ticket before scheduling the enablement call.

nora (CS): draft 15-min script: 0:00-1:00 intro + outcome; 1:00-5:00 demo cold vs warmed session (show latency + token counts); 5:00-9:00 walk runtime snippet + pre-warm steps; 9:00-13:00 review telemetry and identify risk signals; 13:00-15:00 agree mitigations (enable streaming / reduce batch_timeout / enable prefill) and assign an eng owner. also a short troubleshooting matrix: "p95 > 1s -> lower max_batch or enable streaming; cache_hit_rate < 10% -> inspect prompt variability + client prefill; error_rate spike -> capture sample ids + escalate to eng-oncall."

liyah (ENG): add safe rollback guidance: set routing fallback-policy to target=quantized-small for 12-24h while investigating; monitor cache_hit_rate and lat_p95 during the rollback window.

nora (CS): thanks all ":thumbsup:". i'll convert to a printable one-pager with checkboxes (prefill done, warm-run done, traces attached, telemetry snapshot, mitigation chosen, eng owner assigned) and post PDF to the tenant ticket by EOD.
